abstract.p: Feature circuits aim to shed light on LLM behavior by identifying the features that are causally responsible for a given LLM output, and connecting them into a directed graph, or circuit, that explains how both each feature and each output arose. However, performing circuit analysis is challenging: the tools for finding, visualizing, and verifying feature circuits are complex and spread across multiple libraries. To facilitate feature-circuit finding, we introduce circuit-tracer, an open-source library for efficient identification of feature circuits. circuit-tracer provides an integrated pipeline for finding, visualizing, annotating, and performing interventions on such feature circuits, tested with various model sizes, up to 14B parameters. We make circuit-tracer available to both developers and end users, via integration with tools such as Neuronpedia, which provides a user-friendly interface.
